The '''''Liberator''''' was a [[Light freighter/Legends|light freighter]] used by a group of [[Pirate/Legends|pirates]] to attack a [[Starship/Legends|starship]] crewed by adventurers who had been contracted to ferry [[Spice/Legends|spice]] from [[Nigel VI]] to [[Lohopa II]].<ref name="P">{{WEGCite|story=The Package (adventure)|book=Twin Stars of Kira (sourcebook)}}</ref>
